## R Markdown

# Preprocesing

```{r}
df = read.csv(here::here("Data","VMP_extero","raw_hrd.csv")) %>% 
    mutate(DecisionRT = as.numeric(DecisionRT),
           ConfidenceRT = as.numeric(ConfidenceRT),
         Confidence = as.numeric(Confidence),
         ResponseCorrect = as.numeric(ifelse(ResponseCorrect == "1",1,
                                             ifelse(ResponseCorrect == "1.0",1,
                                                    ifelse(ResponseCorrect == "True",1,
                                                           ifelse(ResponseCorrect == "0",0,
                                                                  ifelse(ResponseCorrect == "0.0",0,
                                                                         ifelse(ResponseCorrect == "False",0,NA))))))),
         Decision = ifelse(Decision == "More",1,ifelse(Decision == "Less",0,NA))) %>% 
  mutate(participant_id = as.numeric(as.factor(participant_id))) %>%
  filter(Modality == "Extero",
         session == 1) %>% 
  filter(DecisionRT < 8 & DecisionRT > 0.1)%>% 
  select(ResponseCorrect,participant_id,DecisionRT,Decision, Confidence, ConfidenceRT, Alpha,cohort)  %>% drop_na() %>% 
  rename(
    Confidence = Confidence,
    X  = Alpha,
    Y = Decision,
    Correct = ResponseCorrect,
    RT = DecisionRT,
    subject = participant_id
  ) %>% 
  mutate(Confidence = Confidence/100)

```

```{r, fig.height=7,fig.width=12, message=F, error=F,warning=F}
n_subj <- length(unique(df %>% filter(!subject %in% c("16","46","227","233","249","263","275","312","298","300","326","397","470","546")) %>% .$subject))
subject_chunks <- split(1:n_subj, ceiling(seq_along(1:n_subj) / 10))

plots <- lapply(subject_chunks, function(chunk) plot_subjects(df%>% filter(!subject %in% c("16","46","227","233","249","263","275","312","298","300","326","397","470","546")), chunk, bin = 7))
plots[[1]]
plots[[2]]

```

```{r, fig.height=7,fig.width=12}

df1 = df %>% filter(!subject %in% c("16","46","227","233","249","263","275","312","298","300","326","397","470","546"))

df1$subject = as.numeric(as.factor(df1$subject))

t_p_s = df1 %>% group_by(subject) %>% summarize(n = n())


ends <- cumsum(t_p_s$n)

# Calculate the start points
starts <- c(1, head(ends, -1) + 1)

# mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","ss","ACC_Bin_hier_Correct.stan"))
# mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","ss","ACC_Bin_hier_Correct_rtstim.stan"))
mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","RTmodels","rtstim.stan"))

datastan = list(N = nrow(df1),
                S = length(unique(df1$subject)),
                starts = starts,
                minRT = df1 %>% group_by(subject) %>% summarize(minRT = min(RT)) %>% .$minRT,
                ends = ends,
                t_p_s = t_p_s$n,
                X = df1$X,
                X_scaled = (df1$X - mean(df1$X)) / sd(df1$X),
                S_id = df1$subject,
                RT = df1$RT,
                ACC = df1$Correct,
                K = length(unique(df1$Confidence)),
                Conf = df1$Confidence,
                binom_y = df1$Y)


cor <-mod$sample(
  data = datastan,
  refresh = 10,
  iter_sampling = 1500,
  iter_warmup = 500,
  adapt_delta = 0.99,
  max_treedepth = 13,
  init  = 0,
  parallel_chains = 4)

cor$save_object(here::here("Saved models","VMP_full_standard.rds"))




mod2 = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","RTmodels","two_ints.stan"))

datastan = list(N = nrow(df1),
                S = length(unique(df1$subject)),
                starts = starts,
                minRT = df1 %>% group_by(subject) %>% summarize(minRT = min(RT)) %>% .$minRT,
                ends = ends,
                t_p_s = t_p_s$n,
                X = df1$X,
                X_scaled = (df1$X - mean(df1$X)) / sd(df1$X),
                S_id = df1$subject,
                RT = df1$RT,
                ACC = df1$Correct,
                K = length(unique(df1$Confidence)),
                Conf = df1$Confidence,
                binom_y = df1$Y)


two_ints <-mod2$sample(
  data = datastan,
  refresh = 10,
  iter_sampling = 1500,
  iter_warmup = 500,
  adapt_delta = 0.99,
  max_treedepth = 13,
  init  = 0,
  parallel_chains = 4)

two_ints$save_object(here::here("Saved models","VMP_full_twoints.rds"))


twointsloo = two_ints$loo()
corloo = cor$loo()

loo::loo_compare(list(twointsloo,corloo))


# mod3 = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","RTmodels","pure.stan"))
mod3 = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","ss","Pure","pure.stan"))

datastan = list(N = nrow(df1),
                S = length(unique(df1$subject)),
                starts = starts,
                minRT = df1 %>% group_by(subject) %>% summarize(minRT = min(RT)) %>% .$minRT,
                ends = ends,
                t_p_s = t_p_s$n,
                X = df1$X,
                X_scaled = (df1$X - mean(df1$X)) / sd(df1$X),
                S_id = df1$subject,
                RT = df1$RT,
                ACC = df1$Correct,
                   K = length(unique(df1$Confidence)),
                Conf = df1$Confidence,
                binom_y = df1$Y)


pure <-mod3$sample(
  data = datastan,
  refresh = 10,
  iter_sampling = 1500,
  iter_warmup = 500,
  adapt_delta = 0.99,
  max_treedepth = 13,
  init  = 0,
  parallel_chains = 4)

pure$save_object(here::here("Saved models","VMP_full_pure.rds"))

twointsloobin = two_ints$loo("log_lik_bin")
corloobin = cor$loo("log_lik_bin")
pureloo = pure$loo()

loo::loo_compare(list(twointsloobin,corloobin,pureloo))
```
